verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own documentation describes local, offline processing: documents can be chatted with entirely offline, and Bionic's voice and audio data never leaves the device. That structurally keeps the data away from any vendor training pipeline. However, the evidence never states a no-training policy or a training opt-out, and the never-leaves-device guarantee is only explicit for voice and audio. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is not used for model training, a privacy guarantee covering all chat and prompt data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline
Download and run local LLMs like gpt-oss or Llama, Qwen
